Additional HTTP Methods.description: A comma-separated list of non-standard HTTP Methods that should be allowed
Additional HTTP Methods.name: Additional HTTP Methods

Allowed Paths.description: A Regular Expression that specifies the valid HTTP Paths that are allowed in the incoming URL Requests. If this value is specified and the path of the HTTP Requests does not match this Regular Expression, the Processor will respond with a 404: NotFound
Allowed Paths.name: Allowed Paths

allowableValues.description: Processor will not authenticate clients. Anyone can communicate with this Processor anonymously
Processor will try to verify the client but if unable to verify will allow the client to communicate anonymously
Processor will reject communications from any client unless the client provides a certificate that is trusted by the TrustStorespecified in the SSL Context Service

Client Authentication.description: Specifies whether or not the Processor should authenticate clients. This value is ignored if the <SSL Context Service> Property is not specified or the SSL Context provided uses only a KeyStore and not a TrustStore.
Client Authentication.name: Client Authentication

Container Queue Size.description: The size of the queue for Http Request Containers
Container Queue Size.name: Container Queue Size

Default URL Character Set.description: The character set to use for decoding URL parameters if the HTTP Request does not supply one
Default URL Character Set.name: Default URL Character Set

HTTP Context Map.description: The HTTP Context Map Controller Service to use for caching the HTTP Request Information
HTTP Context Map.name: HTTP Context Map

allowableValues.description: HTTP/2 and HTTP/1.1 negotiated based on requested protocols

HTTP Protocols.description: HTTP Protocols supported for Application Layer Protocol Negotiation with TLS
HTTP Protocols.name: HTTP Protocols

Hostname.description: The Hostname to bind to. If not specified, will bind to all hosts
Hostname.name: Hostname

Listening Port.description: The Port to listen on for incoming HTTP requests
Listening Port.expressionLanguageScopeDescription: Environment variables defined at JVM level and system properties
Listening Port.name: Listening Port

Maximum Threads.description: The maximum number of threads that the embedded HTTP server will use for handling requests.
Maximum Threads.name: Maximum Threads

Multipart Read Buffer Size.description: The threshold size, at which the contents of an incoming file would be written to disk. Only applies for requests with Content-Type: multipart/form-data. It is used to prevent denial of service type of attacks, to prevent filling up the heap or disk space.
Multipart Read Buffer Size.name: Multipart Read Buffer Size

Multipart Request Max Size.description: The max size of the request. Only applies for requests with Content-Type: multipart/form-data, and is used to prevent denial of service type of attacks, to prevent filling up the heap or disk space
Multipart Request Max Size.name: Multipart Request Max Size

Parameters to Attributes.description: A comma-separated list of HTTP parameters or form data to output as attributes
Parameters to Attributes.name: Parameters to Attributes

Request Header Maximum Size.description: The maximum supported size of HTTP headers in requests sent to this processor
Request Header Maximum Size.name: Request Header Maximum Size

SSL Context Service.description: The SSL Context Service to use in order to secure the server. If specified, the server will accept only HTTPS requests; otherwise, the server will accept only HTTP requests
SSL Context Service.name: SSL Context Service

supportedRelationships.description: All content that is received is routed to the 'success' relationship
supportedRelationships.name: success

typeDescription: Starts an HTTP Server and listens for HTTP Requests. For each request, creates a FlowFile and transfers to 'success'. This Processor is designed to be used in conjunction with the HandleHttpResponse Processor in order to create a Web Service. In case  of a multipart request, one FlowFile is generated for each part.

writesAttributes.description: An identifier that allows the HandleHttpRequest and HandleHttpResponse to coordinate which FlowFile belongs to which HTTP Request/Response.
writesAttributes.name: http.context.identifier

writesAttributes.description: The MIME Type of the data, according to the HTTP Header "Content-Type"
writesAttributes.name: mime.type

writesAttributes.description: The part of the request URL that is considered the Servlet Path
writesAttributes.name: http.servlet.path

writesAttributes.description: The part of the request URL that is considered to be the Context Path
writesAttributes.name: http.context.path

writesAttributes.description: The HTTP Method that was used for the request, such as GET or POST
writesAttributes.name: http.method

writesAttributes.description: IP address/hostname of the server
writesAttributes.name: http.local.name

writesAttributes.description: Listening port of the server
writesAttributes.name: http.server.port

writesAttributes.description: The query string portion of the Request URL
writesAttributes.name: http.query.string

writesAttributes.description: The hostname of the requestor
writesAttributes.name: http.remote.host

writesAttributes.description: The hostname:port combination of the requestor
writesAttributes.name: http.remote.addr

writesAttributes.description: The username of the requestor
writesAttributes.name: http.remote.user

writesAttributes.description: The protocol used to communicate
writesAttributes.name: http.protocol

writesAttributes.description: The full Request URL
writesAttributes.name: http.request.uri

writesAttributes.description: The type of HTTP Authorization used
writesAttributes.name: http.auth.type

writesAttributes.description: The name of the authenticated user making the request
writesAttributes.name: http.principal.name

writesAttributes.description: Each of query parameters in the request will be added as an attribute, prefixed with "http.query.param."
writesAttributes.name: http.query.param.XXX

writesAttributes.description: Form parameters in the request that are configured by "Parameters to Attributes List" will be added as an attribute, prefixed with "http.param.". Putting form parameters of large size is not recommended.
writesAttributes.name: http.param.XXX

writesAttributes.description: The Distinguished Name of the requestor. This value will not be populated unless the Processor is configured to use an SSLContext Service
writesAttributes.name: http.subject.dn

writesAttributes.description: The Distinguished Name of the entity that issued the Subject's certificate. This value will not be populated unless the Processor is configured to use an SSLContext Service
writesAttributes.name: http.issuer.dn

writesAttributes.description: X.509 Client Certificate Subject Alternative Name value from mutual TLS authentication. The attribute name has a zero-based index ordered according to the content of Client Certificate
writesAttributes.name: http.certificate.sans.N.name

writesAttributes.description: X.509 Client Certificate Subject Alternative Name type from mutual TLS authentication. The attribute name has a zero-based index ordered according to the content of Client Certificate. The attribute value is one of the General Names from RFC 3280 Section 4.1.2.7
writesAttributes.name: http.certificate.sans.N.nameType

writesAttributes.description: Each of the HTTP Headers that is received in the request will be added as an attribute, prefixed with "http.headers." For example, if the request contains an HTTP Header named "x-my-header", then the value will be added to an attribute named "http.headers.x-my-header"
writesAttributes.name: http.headers.XXX

writesAttributes.description: Each of the HTTP Headers that is received in the multipart request will be added as an attribute, prefixed with "http.headers.multipart." For example, if the multipart request contains an HTTP Header named "content-disposition", then the value will be added to an attribute named "http.headers.multipart.content-disposition"
writesAttributes.name: http.headers.multipart.XXX

writesAttributes.description: For requests with Content-Type "multipart/form-data", the part's content size is recorded into this attribute
writesAttributes.name: http.multipart.size

writesAttributes.description: For requests with Content-Type "multipart/form-data", the part's content type is recorded into this attribute
writesAttributes.name: http.multipart.content.type

writesAttributes.description: For requests with Content-Type "multipart/form-data", the part's name is recorded into this attribute
writesAttributes.name: http.multipart.name

writesAttributes.description: For requests with Content-Type "multipart/form-data", when the part contains an uploaded file, the name of the file is recorded into this attribute. Files are stored temporarily at the default temporary-file directory specified in "java.io.File" Java Docs)
writesAttributes.name: http.multipart.filename

writesAttributes.description: For requests with Content-Type "multipart/form-data", the part's index is recorded into this attribute. The index starts with 1.
writesAttributes.name: http.multipart.fragments.sequence.number

writesAttributes.description: For requests with Content-Type "multipart/form-data", the count of all parts is recorded into this attribute.
writesAttributes.name: http.multipart.fragments.total.number
